summary: Provisioned AWS infrastructure end to end in Terraform — API Gateway, Lambda, least-privilege IAM, CloudWatch — wired into GitHub Actions. Built a log pipeline that decoded gzip-compressed, base64-encoded CloudWatch test logs into structured Dynatrace records, and a service-health dashboard the operations team adopted in place of manual log inspection.
highlight: Killed a 25-second downstream read timeout with a dual-Lambda fan-out: the first Lambda returns 201 immediately and spawns the second to do the slow work in the background.

summary: Prototyped a three-tier storage system over PubMed's 36-million-article corpus — Weaviate as the hot vector index, MongoDB for warm metadata, S3 for cold archive — plus a batch ingestion pipeline pulling full-text articles over FTP and pre-computing dense embeddings. Flask endpoints served retrieved article context into LLM prompts.
highlight: Chose Weaviate over Pinecone and AWS Elasticsearch after benchmarking all three on retrieval latency, hybrid-search support, and ingestion throughput.

summary: Fine-tuned BERT-family models on MedQuAD's 60,000+ NIH-sourced clinical question-answer pairs, preprocessing into SQuAD-style format and comparing baselines on precision, recall, and F1. Scoped a medical entity recognition pipeline pairing LayoutLM for spatially-structured EHR documents with ClinicalBERT.

RLHF evaluation: reviewing model-generated Python across algorithmic and software-engineering tasks, writing critiques that identify logic errors and edge-case failures, and ranking candidate responses into preference data.
One-on-one Python and Java tutoring for 100+ students — debugging their code live, working through data structures, recursion, and complexity analysis.
